import subprocess, time, shlex, json
commands = [
  'make build',
  'python3 -m pytest tests/test_api.py tests/test_routes.py -q',
  'npx vitest run',
]
results = []
for cmd in commands:
    start = time.perf_counter()
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, text=True, capture_output=True)
    duration_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
    print(f'=== COMMAND: {cmd} ===')
    if proc.stdout:
        print(proc.stdout.rstrip())
    if proc.stderr:
        print(proc.stderr.rstrip())
    print(f'=== EXIT: {proc.returncode} DURATION_MS: {duration_ms} ===')
    results.append({"command": cmd, "exit": proc.returncode, "duration_ms": duration_ms})
print('=== SUMMARY ===')
print(json.dumps(results))
